fullContent:
Parinatakeryadi Taila (Oil) 
 Reference: Siddha Yoga, Taila Yoga Prakarana 
 Introduction 
 Parinatakeryadi Taila is a traditional Ayurvedic medicated oil used primarily in the treatment of neurological and musculoskeletal disorders. 
 Ingredients 
 
 Devadhupa ( Shorea robusta ) 
 Jambira ( Citrus aurantifolia ) 
 Tila taila ( Sesamum Indicum ) 
 Haridra ( Curcuma longa ) 
 Narikela ( Cocos nucifera ) 
 Swarasa 
 
 Method of Preparation 
 All ingredients are added to til oil and taila is prepared according. 
 How to Use? 
 Parinatakeryadi Taila (Oil) is applied externally. 
 Therapeutic Uses 
 
 This Ayurvedic Medicine is used in a condition called Frozen Shoulder (Avabahuka) where the shoulder girdle will be stiff. 
 It is also useful in treatment for Sciatica syndrome (Gridhrasi). 
 
 
 
Note:- This is pure classical Ayurvedic medicine and should be strictly consumed only after prescription of an Ayurvedic doctor and to be taken under medical supervision only.
